purpose: Select functional SAE material using all public CausalGym development tasks and a lexical/number-crossed agreement panel before new SAE training
dataset_license: MIT as declared in the official dataset card
distractor_index_rule: (5 * subject_index + 3) mod 16; if equal use next index
crossed_rule: All sixteen lexical blocks times three syntax templates times subject number2 times distractor number2. Each input has two donors: toggle only subject number, or toggle only distractor number; same lemma and remaining spans preserved. No cases selected by model/SAE/target result.
numerical_note: Bound fixed from earlier observed float32 batched GPTNeoX logprob differences up to0.00125; actual maximum and label reversals reported. No tolerance tuning on this panel. Within-identical-batch no-op must be exact.
budget: <=10min GPU,one auxiliary CPU thread,<1GBoutput; all public2900development pairs plus192crossedinputs and384donors for each model. No SAE training,FCC fitting,or task test split.
scope: Material/model/layer development, not a novel CausalGym result or FCC contribution. Public pairs can change lemma and labels; authored crossed panel removes those particular confounds. Final confirmation uses new data after method selection.
revision: V1 retained after first crossed-patch metadata int64 JSON serialization failure; V2 casts row identities to int and serializes before counting persisted records. Numerical design, inputs and model configuration unchanged.
